description: This file provides a class implementation for configuring, processing, and transforming audio transcription requests and responses specifically between OpenAI's API and Deepgram's API within a speech-to-text system. It includes methods for handling audio data, mapping parameters, constructing request URLs, and parsing Deepgram's response into a format compatible with OpenAI's expected output.

classes.name: DeepgramAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for handling the transcription process by mapping OpenAI parameters to Deepgram's API, transforming audio data, parsing responses, and constructing request URLs for Deepgram's audio transcription API.

methods.name: List[OpenAIAudioTranscriptionOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns the list of optional OpenAI parameters supported for a given model, currently only 'language'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default OpenAI parameters into optional parameters for the request, filtering only supported ones.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the specific exception class for errors encountered during transcription, here it uses DeepgramException.

methods.name: AudioTranscriptionRequestData transform_audio_transcription_request( self, model: str, audio_file: FileTypes, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Processes and packages the audio file input into a data structure suitable for Deepgram, supporting file path, filename and content tuple, or binary data.

methods.name: TranscriptionResponse transform_audio_transcription_response( self, raw_response: Response, )
methods.description: Transforms Deepgram's raw API response into a standardized TranscriptionResponse object, handling diarization, language detection, durations, and word timestamps.

methods.name: str _reconstruct_diarized_transcript(self, words: list)
methods.description: Reconstructs diarized transcripts from a list of words with speaker info, formatting text with speaker labels.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for Deepgram with query parameters, including model and optional parameters.

methods.name: str _format_param_value(self, value)
methods.description: Formats parameter values into string suitable for URL query parameters, converting booleans to lowercase strings.

methods.name: dict _build_query_params(self, optional_params: dict, model: str)
methods.description: Builds and filters query parameters based on optional parameters and model, formatting values for URL encoding.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Returns headers with authorization token for API access, fetching the API key securely.
